abhejja.cp: adj. not to be split or divided.
abhejja.p: [Na+bhejja] (ti) CL=9 (A) Indivisible, impenetrable , indestructible, (B) Cannot be separated-divided-broken (C) Undivided-Mixed-United

C: abhejja：a. [a-bhejja，Sk. abhedya] 不被破壞的，不壞的.
abhejja：[adj.] not to be split or divided.

abheda.p: [Na+bheda] (pu) CL=9 (1) (a) Non-damage. (B) Non-violation - non-destruction; Not violating. (C) Not special. Similarity (Ti) (2) (a) No difference - not distinct. (b) Not broken. Not damaged , unbroken,

[န+ဘေဒ]

DOP: bheda m. [ ts ], 1. breaking, splitting apart; breaking up; dissolution; uttering (speech); Abh 759 (~o vidāro); 991; Vin III 5, 7 (te kāyassa ~ā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapannā; Vism 427, 6 : upādinnakkhandhapariccāgā); M I 49, 23 (yaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhā tamhā sattanikāyā cuti cavanatā ~o antaradhānaṃ maccumaraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ ~o kaḷebarassa nikkhepo idaṃ vuccat’ āvuso maraṇaṃ); A II 66, 11 (kāyassa ~ā; Mp III 178, 22 : kāyassa ~ena); Dhp 140 (kāyassa ~ā duppañño nirayaṃ sopapajjati); Sn 849 (vītataṇho purā ~ā; Nidd-a I 319, 29 : sarīrabhedā); Th 493 (~ā imassa kāyassa jīvitassa ca saṅkhayā añño punabbhavo natthi); Ap 550, 12 (dīpodayaṃ ca ~aṃ ca disvā); Vism 231, 15 (muggarābhitāḷitānaṃ mattikabhājanānaṃ ~o viya); 644, 22 (sabbasaṅkhārānaṃ uppādaṭhitipavattanimittaṃ vissajjetvā ~am eva passati); Sv 114, 27 (cakkhādīnaṃ ~ato balavataraṃ pi cittassa ~aṃ na passati); Ps I 135, 16 foll. (lokiyassa ca saraṇagamanassa duvidho ~o, sāvajjo anavajjo ca … lokuttarassa pana n’ ev’ atthi ~o); — ifc see gaṇḍa-, puṭa-, vacī-, vākya-; — 2. splitting; setting at variance, sowing discord; disunion, dissension; schism; Abh 349 (upajāpo tu ~o ca); 991; Vin II 86, 37 (taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ … ~āya saṃvatteyya; Sp 1193, 22 : ~āyā ti saṅghabhedāya); III 172, 31 (yo pana bhikkhu samaggassa saṅghassa ~āya parakkameyya); IV 12, 6 (imassa sutvā amussa akkhāyanti imassa ~āya); Sv 522, 24 (~en’ eva te gahessāma); Mp IV 129, 1 (mittehi bhedanasaṃvattaniko ti mittehi ~aṃ saṃvatteti); Th-a III 55, 30 (aññe māṇavā ācariyena saddhiṃ ~aṃ akaṃsu); — ifc see cakka-, saṅgha-; — 3. breaking; violation; breach; betrayal; Ja V 80, 13* (mantassa ~aṃ parisaṅkamāno); VI 389, 2* (tasmā manto khippam upeti ~aṃ); Ap 94, 28 (bhavissati tadā ~o); Vism 64, 10 (… dhutaṅgaṃ bhijjati, ayaṃ ettha ~o); Ud-a 416, 19 (so pan’ assa sīlābhāvo duvidho asamādānena vā samādinnassa ~ena vā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr sīlabhāvo); — 4. breaking or splitting up; distinguishing; classification; division, subdivision, kind, sort, category (frequently ifc); Vism 455, 14 ; 462, 4 (yattako viññāṇassa ~o tattako saññāyā ti); 493, 1 (bhedābhedā ti jīvitindriyass’ eva c’ ettha ~o); Sp 124, 19 (kusalādīhi ~ehi sabbadhamme … vibhajitvā); Spk III 301, 27 (ekaṃ vālaṃ sattadhā bhinditvā tassa ekaṃ ~aṃ gahetvā); Pj II 47, 24 (ete ca ~ā paññādhikasaddhādhikaviriyādhikavasena ñātabbā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ete tayo pabhedā); As 319, 22 (ayaṃ bherisaddādinā ~ena bhinno pi saddo lakkhaṇādīhi abhinno yeva); — °’- āsaṅki(n) , mfn. , apprehensive of discord; Sn 255 (~ī randham evānupassī) = Ja III 192, 29* (193, 9´ foll.: ajja bhijjissati sve bhijjissatī ti evaṃ mittassa bhedam eva āsaṅkati); — °- purakkhaka , °-purekkhaka, mfn., aiming at disunion, schism; Utt-vn 302 (nassant’ ete vinassantu iti ~ā … thullaccayaṃ, Be so; Ee °-purakkhato; cf Utt-vn-ṭīkā [ Be ] II 440, 18 : purakkhakā ti ettha sāmi-atthe paccattavacanaṃ, °-purekkhakassa, °-purekkhakāyā ti attho); — °- purekkhāra , mfn. , aiming at disunion, schism; Vin I 131, 31 (~ā uposathaṃ karonti pātimokkhaṃ uddisanti); Sp 219, 1 (~-tāya); Spk II 147, 10 (~-tā); — abheda , m. , not breaking; no breach; no division; lack of division, of classification; Vism 53, 15 ; 477, 9 (~ena hi pañcasu khandhesu attagāhapatitaṃ veneyyajanaṃ); 493, 3 ; Sp 442, 17 (tassa atthato ~aṃ dassetuṃ); — see also nakhabhedakaṃ ( sv nakha ), sabhedaka.
CPD: a-bheda , m. [ ts .], no difference, identity; only in the cpd. abhedôpacāra ( see upacāra), metonomy; vīṇā-vādanaṃ sippam assa veṇiko, vīṇāvādanaṃ ~ena vīṇā nāma, Pay fol. ṅau 1 ( cf. abhedanamukha.p: [Abhedana+mukha] (na) CL=8 opening that is not surgically inserted, but that appears as a result of Kamma
a: ဖောက်ခွဲ၍-ခွဲစိတ်၍-ပြုအပ်သည် မဟုတ်သော-ကံသက်သက်ကြောင့်သာလျှင် ဖြစ်သော-အပေါက်ဝ၊ ခွဲစိတ်ခြင်းကြောင့် မဟုတ်ဘဲ ကံကြောင့်ဖြစ်သော အမာဝ။
